description: Least-privilege capability set for the PulseTrader main window (ADR-0020). Core app/event/window/webview permissions only. NO filesystem, shell or HTTP capability is granted, and scripts/check-capabilities.sh asserts that absence at both the capability and the dependency level rather than trusting review. Note that the app's own #[tauri::command] functions need no permission entry -- Tauri v2 permissions gate CORE and PLUGIN commands, so this list stays short as screens are added. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` / `-allow-close` / `-allow-minimize` are granted individually because `core:window:default` is read/getter-only -- the app-drawn titlebar under `decorations: false` is the window's only chrome, so the webview itself must be able to move, close and minimize the window.
